title: wiretap: Handle comments in .scap event blocks
description:
Make sure we properly support reading and writing the various .scap
event block types.

Add support for reading and writing options to the various .scap event
block types, which adds support for event comments.

Remove an unneeded syscall header field.

Use "Event comment" where needed in a few places.

notes.body: Where ".scap" means "pcapng file written by Stratoshark"?
That and anything using libscap, particularly Falco and the sysdig CLI tool. This and https://github.com/falcosecurity/libs/pull/2302 should help improve compatibility between each tool and library.
